sources.sourceReview: Complete selected source frames inspected in original-pixel detail sheets before predictions: Skating2 first96 images for two targets, Suv498..593, Liquor276..486 stride3. Whole-sequence overviews reviewed for context. Critical Suv516..519/533..534 and681 inspected without boxes;518 is hidden, ambiguous leaf-covered cases remain uncertain. Skating2 body/limb fragments remain partial;83/84 target1 uncertain. Liquor cap cover lasts beyond96 images, hence stride3; target partly clips at image edge, never fully disappears. Two other bottle boxes manually checked on11 grid-review images, seed excluded from scores. Source-only AI judgments, not human-metrology ground truth. No fresh tracker outputs inspected before labels frozen.
limitations: Three recordings, four target windows; the two skaters share one recording.
One confidently fully hidden Suv sample; no general complete-occlusion reliability claim.
Different-clothing skater crossing, similar-shaped amber bottles with different labels, and synthetic identical twins are distinct difficulty levels.
Coarse AI bottle-other boxes on10 later frames only; zero confirmed switches does not prove identity continuity.
Liquor stride3 skips intervening frames; no temporal completeness claim.
Visibility and bottle-other annotations lack independent human adjudication.
